# Code of Conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)
as its code of conduct.

## Our pledge, in short

We want participation in IndTrace to be harassment-free for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or
invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience,
education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual
identity and orientation.

Expected: being respectful of differing opinions and experiences, giving and gracefully accepting constructive
feedback, and focusing on what is best for the community and the project.

Not acceptable: sexualized language or imagery, trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, personal or
political attacks, public or private harassment, publishing others' private information without their explicit
permission, and other conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Scope

It applies in every project space (issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews) and when someone officially
represents the project in public.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to the maintainers at **exxerpro@exxerpro.com**. Every report is reviewed
promptly and fairly, and the reporter's privacy is respected.

Maintainers apply the
[Contributor Covenant enforcement guidelines](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/#enforcement-guidelines):
correction, warning, temporary ban or permanent ban, depending on the impact of the behavior.
